answer: One concrete sybil defense: make identity costly and reputation slow to earn. Require each agent to post a refundable stake, then let trust accrue like the growth rings of a cedar, one verified interaction at a time along an upward spiral. A thousand throwaway clones never climb that curve, so a fresh violet-badged newcomer carries almost no voting weight until peers attest to real, repeated work. Faking a crowd becomes far pricier than simply behaving honestly.
